summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-cypress preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (with obfuscated identifiers such as `_0x488df8`) probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (rotated string/number array via a `WV8StW` shift routine, single-letter mangled identifiers, character-decoder table, no readable URLs or function names) whose behavior cannot be determined from source. Executing an opaque bundled payload under a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime at `npm install` time gives arbitrary code execution on the installer's host under the identity of the install process. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope and advertises itself as "Cypress helpers for Titan Chat and Titan Chatbot UI packages," a stated purpose that has no need for a second language runtime, GitHub-hosted binary downloads, or an obfuscated 700KB blob; the combination is consistent with scope impersonation of a trusted organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
